title: MrJ-ArduinoRailwayFX — device type catalogue
description: UI metadata for every device type served by /api/device-types. Drives the device editor (type list, wiring pin count) and the cockpit (card rendering category, state buttons). Each key is a device type name matching config.json devices[].type and the firmware C++ class name.

category.description:
Rendering category. Controls which cockpit card widget is used:
  light     → generic ON/OFF toggle card (includes multi-pin alternating devices like RailwayCrossingLights)
  signal    → multi-state button card (states required)
  servo     → UART speed-preset card (states required, v may be 'REV')
  i2c_servo → positional I²C servo card (positions from config, STOP + N position buttons); board field shown in editor
  i2c_motor → continuous I²C motor card (ON/OFF with speed from config)
  traffic   → traffic-light card (fixed GO/FLASH/STOP buttons)
  static    → read-only label (no user control)
  audio     → audio player card

stateValue.description: State sent to /api/device or /api/servo. Integer for signal states; 'REV' string for the servo reverse preset.

stateDef.description: One button in a multi-state card (signal or servo).

v.description: Value posted to the API when this button is pressed.

c.description: CSS class applied to the button for color coding (e.g. 't-stop', 't-go', 't-off').

deviceTypeDef.description: UI descriptor for one device type.

wires.description: Number of wiring values this device type requires (count, not the values themselves). 0 = bus-only device with no physical pin (SerialServo, DfAudio). Distinct from config.json `wiring` which holds the actual pin/channel value(s).

states.description: State button definitions. Required when category is 'signal' or 'servo'. Absent for all other categories.

wire_aspects.description: Per-position wiring-test aspects (DB signals), in canonical pin order: what identifying each pin position should light. Drives the device editor's wiring assistant.

l.description: Aspect label shown to the user (e.g. 'Rouge', 'Orange').

c.description: CSS color hint for the radio swatch (e.g. '#e74c3c').

pin_count_const.description: C++ constant name for the pin-array size (e.g. 'MrJDBBlocSignalState_PIN_COUNT'). Code-generation only — absent for most types.

variable_pins.description: True when the C++ constructor takes (count, pins[]) instead of a fixed-size array. Code-generation only (e.g. StaticLow).

ctor_style.description:
Constructor style used by config_to_cpp.py when generating main.cpp for non-WebUI targets (AVR, etc.).
  single_pin    → new Type(pin)
  multi_pin     → new Type(pins_var)
  variable_pins → new Type(count, pins_var)
  serial_servo  → new Type(&Serial, servo_id)
  audio         → new Type(rx, tx)
  i2c_servo     → PCA9685Servo — not yet supported in code generation
  i2c_motor     → PCA9685Motor — not yet supported in code generation

label.description: Human-readable label for the device type, keyed by language code (e.g. 'fr', 'en').

then.description: Signal and servo types must declare their state buttons.

states.description: Not applicable for this category — must be absent.
